title: NLTK: Uncontrolled recursion in semantic-logic type parser causes denial of service via nested type strings…
description: The NLTK library's semantic-logic type parser has an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the read_type function, which processes nested type strings without a recursion depth limit. This can cause a RecursionError and denial of service when parsing deeply nested type strings. The issue affects versions prior to 3.10.4 and is fixed in version 3.10.4.
